configurationFields.label: Host Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets whether the server will load an official or custom scenario (essentially creating a new game) or load an existing savegame instead. Specify "Official Scenario", "Custom Scenario" or "Savegame" accordingly

configurationFields.label: Official Scenario
configurationFields.description: Set the official scenario to load from rct2game or rct1game. "Load Official Scenario" must also be selected under Host Mode. You can then stop the server and load the relevant savegame by switching Host Mode

configurationFields.label: Custom Scenario
configurationFields.description: Sets a custom scenario to load. "Load Custom Scenario" must also be selected under Host Mode, and the custom scenario file must be in user-data/scenario. You can then stop the server and load the relevant savegame by switching Host Mode

configurationFields.label: Savegame
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the savegame to load from user-data/save. "Load Savegame" must also be selected under Host Mode

configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server as shown publicly

configurationFields.label: Serverbeschreibung
configurationFields.description: Sets the description for the server as shown publiclly

configurationFields.label: Welcome Message
configurationFields.description: Sets the welcome message shown to clients when connecting

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password for players to join the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Advertise Server
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will be able to be advertised on the master server list

configurationFields.label: Advertise Address Selection Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets whether GSCS should automatically select the public IP advertised for the server, or whether it should use the IP set under Server Public IP

configurationFields.label: Server Public IP
configurationFields.description: Sets the public IP advertised for the server, if "Manual" is selected as the Advertise Address Selection Mode. Useful if the host network has multiple public IPs, or the server is behind a public proxy

configurationFields.label: Master Server URL
configurationFields.description: Sets the URL of the master server for server registration

configurationFields.label: Server Admins
configurationFields.description: To create at least the first server admin, edit server-data/users.json and create an entry with Group 0 for the relevant user. Obtain the hash and name for that user from their public key on the client. Other admins can be added this way as well, or the first admin can assign admin permissions to them in-game

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players that may connect to the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Allow Known Keys Only
configurationFields.description: If enabled, only connections from clients with known encryption keys will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Pause Server When Empty
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will be paused if no clients are connected

configurationFields.label: Autosave Interval
configurationFields.description: Sets how often the server autosaves

configurationFields.label: Autosave Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of autosaves to retain

configurationFields.label: Stay Connected On Desync
configurationFields.description: If enabled, clients will remain connected to the server, even if an error/desync occurs

configurationFields.label: Enable Desync Debugging
configurationFields.description: If set, debugging for desync issues will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Log Chat
configurationFields.description: If enabled, chat messages will be logged

configurationFields.label: Log Server Actions
configurationFields.description: If enabled, server actions will be logged

configurationFields.label: Server Release Version
configurationFields.description: Sets the [server release version](https://github.com/OpenRCT2/OpenRCT2/releases) to install. Empty = latest. NOTE: Only include the 3 number version identifier, without the 'v' prefix, such as 0.4.17. Update the server after changing this setting

configurationFields.label: Disable RCT2 Game Files Download
configurationFields.description: If set, GSCS will not download the RCT2 game files from Steam when the server is updated. The files will need to be installed manually in the rct2game directory in the instance's base directory in order to be used. Note that the Official Scenario selector may not work if the manually added files don't match those on Steam

configurationFields.label: Disable RCT1 Game Files Download
configurationFields.description: If set, GSCS will not download the RCT1 game files from Steam when the server is updated. The files will need to be installed manually in the rct1game directory in the instance's base directory in order to be used. Note that the Official Scenario selector may not work if the manually added files don't match those on Steam

deploymentSteps.name: OpenRCT2 Download
deploymentSteps.arguments: -c "cd . && ReleaseVersion={RELEASEVERSION} && [[ -z \"$ReleaseVersion\" ]] && { wget -qO OpenRCT2.AppImage $(wget -qO- https://api.github.com/repos/OpenRCT2/OpenRCT2/releases/latest | grep browser_download_url | cut -d\\\" -f4 | grep linux-x86_64.AppImage) && echo \"Latest OpenRCT2 downloaded\"; } || { wget -qO OpenRCT2.AppImage $(wget -qO- https://api.github.com/repos/OpenRCT2/OpenRCT2/releases/tags/v$ReleaseVersion | grep browser_download_url | cut -d\\\" -f4 | grep linux-x86_64.AppImage) && echo \"OpenRCT2 v$ReleaseVersion downloaded\"; }"

deploymentSteps.name: OpenRCT2 Download
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $ReleaseVersion='{RELEASEVERSION}'; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($ReleaseVersion)) { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri ((Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://api.github.com/repos/OpenRCT2/OpenRCT2/releases/latest').assets | Where-Object { $_.browser_download_url -like '*windows-portable-x64.zip' }).browser_download_url -OutFile 'OpenRCT2.zip'; if ($?) { Write-Output \"Latest OpenRCT2 downloaded\" } } else { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri ((Invoke-RestMethod -UseBasicParsing -Uri "https://api.github.com/repos/OpenRCT2/OpenRCT2/releases/tags/v$ReleaseVersion").assets | Where-Object { $_.browser_download_url -like '*windows-portable-x64.zip' }).browser_download_url -OutFile 'OpenRCT2.zip'; if ($?) { Write-Output \"OpenRCT2 v$ReleaseVersion downloaded\" } }"
